name: Horizon Chart
description: Many long series in little height: each row folds its area into bands of deepening water blue above a baseline and camellia below, read all at once by a vertical rule.

props.name: series
props.type: { label: string; values: number[]; title?: string; baseline?: number }[]
props.description: One row per entry, with a value per label. label sits on the left; title, when given, is used in the summary and table. A row's own baseline overrides the shared one.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per point along the shared time axis, e.g. "14 Mar".

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for each point, for the summary, the live readout and the table.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Indices of the labels to show on the axis. Defaults to evenly spaced labels that fit.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many layers each row folds into. Values beyond the last band are clipped at the row's top.

props.name: baseline
props.description: The value rows are measured from. Above it folds up in blue, below it folds up in red.

props.name: step
props.description: How much each band holds. Defaults to a round step that fits the largest difference from the baseline across all rows, so rows compare directly.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in pixels.

props.name: colors
props.description: The deepest shade above and below the baseline. Shallower bands fade toward the card.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit written after values, e.g. "m".

props.name: format
props.description: Writes a difference from the baseline in the readouts and table. Defaults to a signed number with the unit.

props.name: formatStep
props.description: Writes the band size in the key. Defaults to the number with the unit.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number, already formatted.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the value.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the key under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts delta, action and every other prop of a div.
